papers.title: 3D printing of sacrificial thioester elastomers using digital light processing for templating 3D organoid structures in soft biomatrices.
papers.abstract: Biofabrication allows for the templating of structural features in materials on cellularly-relevant size scales, enabling the generation of tissue-like structures with controlled form and function. This is particularly relevant for growing organoids, where the application of biochemical and biomechanical stimuli can be used to guide the assembly and differentiation of stem cells and form architectures similar to the parent tissue or organ. Recently, ablative laser-scanning techniques was used to create 3D overhang features in collagen hydrogels at size scales of 10-100µm and supported the crypt-villus architecture in intestinal organoids. As a complementary method, providing advantages for high-throughput patterning, we printed thioester functionalized poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) elastomers using digital light processing (DLP) and created sacrificial, 3D shapes that could be molded into soft (G' < 1000 Pa) hydrogel substrates. Specifically, three-arm 1.3 kDa PEG thiol and three-arm 1.6 kDa PEG norbornene, containing internal thioester groups, were photopolymerized to yield degradable elastomers. When incubated in a solution of 300 mM 2-mercaptoethanol (pH 9.0), 1 mm thick 10 mm diameter elastomer discs degraded in <2 h. Using DLP, arrays of features with critical dimensions of 37 ± 4µm, resolutions of 22 ± 5µm, and overhang structures as small as 50µm, were printed on the order of minutes. These sacrificial thioester molds with physiologically relevant features were cast-molded into Matrigel and subsequently degraded to create patterned void spaces with high fidelity. Intestinal stem cells (ISCs) cultured on the patterned Matrigel matrices formed confluent monolayers that conformed to the underlying pattern. DLP printed sacrificial thioester elastomer constructs provide a robust and rapid method to fabricate arrays of 3D organoid-sized features in soft tissue culture substrates and should enable investigations into the effect of epithelial geometry and spacing on the growth and differentiation of ISCs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及任何人工智能或机器学习方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a materials fabrication and cell culture study without computational modeling or process optimization using AI.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于制造器官样结构的快速可降解模板方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用数字光处理打印含硫酯键的PEG弹性体作为牺牲模具。
summary_zh.result: 打印特征分辨率达22微米，可在Matrigel中形成图案化空隙，支持肠道干细胞培养。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞培养验证模板对干细胞单层形成的引导作用。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a rapid and high-throughput method for fabricating sacrificial templates with physiologically relevant 3D features for organoid culture.
summary_en.method: Thioester-functionalized PEG elastomers were photopolymerized via digital light processing to create degradable molds.
summary_en.result: Arrays of features with critical dimensions of 37 µm and overhang structures down to 50 µm were printed and used to pattern Matrigel, supporting intestinal stem cell monolayers.
summary_en.validation: In vitro culture of intestinal stem cells on patterned Matrigel confirmed the fidelity and biocompatibility of the templated structures.

summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial comparing a continuous nursing program with standard care
summary_en.result: The continuous care model significantly improved functional recovery and quality of life

papers.title: Study of Technological Parameters Influence on Quality of Bulk Samples Manufactured from Inconel 718 by the Selective Laser Melting Method
papers.abstract: Технологія вибіркового лазерного топлення -один з видів адитивного виробництва, за якого виріб створюється методом пошарового протоплення порошку металу за допомогою лазерного променя, який рухається по заданій траєкторії згідно

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718镍基高温合金的选择性激光熔化参数，与生物医学植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing for implants, no osseointegration or surface roughness considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化工艺参数对镍基高温合金质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数制造块状样品并分析质量。
summary_zh.result: 确定了工艺参数对密度、表面质量等的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量样品密度和表面粗糙度进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the quality of bulk Inconel 718 samples.
summary_en.method: Bulk samples were fabricated with varying laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters, and their quality was characterized.
summary_en.result: Relationships between process parameters and sample density, surface quality, and mechanical properties were established.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of density and surface roughness were used to validate the effects of parameters.
